broker_url.description: URL of the broker server used to discover Tor clients.

capacity.description: Maximum number of concurrent WebRTC clients the proxy will handle.

log_file.description: Filename for logging output. Empty string defaults to stdout.

relay_url.description: URL of the websocket relay server for traffic forwarding.

stun_url.description: URL of the STUN server for ICE candidate gathering.

unsafe_logging.description: If true, logs will not be scrubbed of potentially sensitive data.
